purpose: Generate concise betting-site-style historical matchup tidbits for the game interface without treating example tidbits as privileged predictive model categories.
guardrails: A displayed tidbit is descriptive context, not a BET, LEAN, PASS, projection adjustment, probability adjustment or model edge.
Do not convert an example such as performance versus .500-plus opponents into a privileged model category unless separately justified and approved.
Do not mine arbitrary tiny-sample combinations merely because they produce an extreme record.
Do not use future results to define a historical condition.
Market-history tidbits may describe historical ATS or O-U results but may not write football projections, True Value, Overall rank or betting recommendations.
The interface may show a generic fact even when that fact has zero predictive authority.
